description:
Revoke a principal's access to a flow (DELETE .../permissions/{principalId}) [DISABLED: set ENABLE_WRITE_OPS=true].
Parameters: flow (required), principalId (required), environment (optional).
Uses Microsoft's unofficial api.flow.microsoft.com endpoint, which Microsoft labels unsupported; behavior may change.

environment.description: Environment id (from list_environments). Omit to use the user's default environment.

principalId.description: Azure AD object id of the user/group to revoke.

name: remove_flow_owner
